name: Aquaguard Aspire Blaze
summary: The Aquaguard ASPIRE Blaze Smart Purifier (RO+UV) is a premium smart water purifier designed to deliver safe, healthy, and convenient drinking water. It features 9-stage RO+UV purification , Wi-Fi connectivity , instant hot water dispensing , and a dual stainless steel storage tank for enhanced hygiene and durability.
intro: The Aquaguard Aspire Blaze RO+UV is a premium water purifier featuring 9-stage purification, instant hot water, UV e-boiling technology, and 3-in-1 Active Copper Infusion. It comes with a 5.6-litre dual stainless steel tank, 2-year filter life, and water-saving RO technology for safe, healthy, and convenient drinking water.
features: 9-Stage RO+UV Purification for safe and clean drinking water.
Instant Hot Water for tea, coffee, and instant meals.
UV e-boiling Technology provides protection equivalent to boiled water.
3-in-1 Active Copper Infusion enriches water with copper.
Dual Stainless Steel Tanks help maintain hygienic water storage.
Water Saving RO Technology with over 40% water recovery.
TDS Meter to check water quality.
Additional Mega Sediment Filter for improved pre-filtration.
Dual Dispense Technology for hot and ambient water.
Removable Drip Tray for easy cleaning and maintenance.
Water Saving RO Technology with over 40% water recovery .
